agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 24, 2020 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Public comments regarding items not listed on this agenda (oral communications) must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Board and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Board President.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Board and made a part of the meeting record.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Public comments regarding consent calendar items on this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov.
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Board and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Board President.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Board and made a part of the meeting record.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 20, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-06-24 SDWD Item S08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Acting Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants List.
2020-06-24 SDWD Item S08B Warrants
8C.
Biennial review of the San Dieguito Water District (SDWD) Conflict of Interest Code and Filers. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Receive the report and file.
2020-06-24 SDWD Item S08C Conflict of Interest Code Biennial Review
8D.
Authorization to enter into a Professional Services Contract with Woodward & Curran, Inc. (Woodward) to prepare the 2020 Urban Water Management Plan Update (UWMP). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with Woodward in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney, in the amount of $63,369 plus a 10 percent staff-authorized contingency for a total not-to-exceed amount of $69,706.
2020-06-24 SDWD Item S08D UWMP Consultant Agreement
8E.
Authorization of a License Agreement with the Self-Realization Fellowship (SRF) for an Existing Water Main. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
Authorize the City Manager to enter into a temporary agreement with SRF in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney, in the amount of $1,000 per year for use of land where an existing water main was discovered outside of the District’s easement.
2020-06-24 SDWD Item S08E SRF License Agreement
8F.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2019-20 3rd Quarter Budget Report Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
District Board to receive and file this report reflecting a projected available net position of $10,988,483.
2020-06-24 SDWD Item S08F FY19-20 3rd Quarter Budget Report
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
Public comments regarding Action Items listed on this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Board and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Board President.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Board and made a part of the meeting record.
10A.
Fiscal Year 2020/21 San Dieguito Water District Budget (“Second-Year Revise”). Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Resolution No. 2020-08, entitled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District, Approving the Fiscal Year 2020/21 San Dieguito Water District Operating and Capital Budget (Second-Year Revise);” and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-09 Approving Position Titles and Pay Ranges for the San Dieguito Water District for Fiscal Year 2020/21.
2020-06-24 SDWD Item S10A FY 20-21 2nd Yr Revise Budget Approval
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Update on the Lake Hodges Dam project.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON AUGUST 26, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
